description: Self-hosted Renovate runner for the SylphxAI org (see runner/README.md). `repositories` is the scope; the workflow runs one job per entry. Other options are repository defaults: a repository with its own Renovate config overrides them.

github-actions.description: The runner's App has no `workflows` permission yet, so GitHub rejects any push that edits .github/workflows. Remove this block when the dedicated App with `workflows: write` replaces it.
